task: CRANE+ V2 bow: zero arm posture to joint3=0.60 rad, other arm joints=0, gripper=-0.5236
scope: New experiment separate from already submitted MuJoCo delivery project
compute: Google Colab T4, existing subscription; no additional purchases

demonstrations.provenance: Scripted replay of published 0.05-rad keyboard commands, recorded from Gazebo joint feedback; not human demonstrations
demonstrations.quality_gate: finite observations, complete joint names, strictly increasing timestamps, target reached, valid limits; rejected episodes logged

split_unit: whole episode / scene, never random frames

test.access: one final evaluation after model selection; no tuning on test

success: all 5 joint errors <=0.05 rad and max joint speed <=0.10 rad/s continuously for 0.5 simulation seconds, within 8 seconds
selection: validation success first, terminal RMSE second; report latency and smoothness separately, do not hide failed runs
reproducibility: save seed, source hashes, dependency versions, checkpoints, per-episode traces, errors and wall time
claim_limit: Best among tested configurations under this protocol, never a claim of global optimum. Gazebo reproduction and offline diagnostics are reported separately.
stopping_rule: Finish planned comparisons and validation selection; add further trials only for a recorded hypothesis. Preserve final holdout; if new development follows test disclosure, create a new untouched test split.

pre_training_amendments.reason: Verify feasibility and show the limitation of a single fixed-target task
pre_training_amendments.addition: Validation-only known-target controller reference, excluded from learned-model selection.

pre_training_amendments.reason: No human demonstration bags supplied; reproducible simulated collection
pre_training_amendments.addition: Use actual Gazebo feedback JSON with an in-memory adapter reproducing lesson configuration and conversion conventions, not a byte-identical LeRobot bag conversion; report explicitly.

pre_training_amendments.reason: Separate joint-order and time-target hypotheses instead of crediting a bundled fix to one cause
pre_training_amendments.addition: Two 200-step batch-2 ablations: order_only_200 retains original timing and padding; time_only_200 retains original joint order and padding. Both evaluated on validation, eligible for model selection.
